prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: wide motorcycle rental website hero photograph.
Primary request: editorial photo of one black modern 250cc naked street motorcycle parked in a brutalist concrete garage opening.
Scene/backdrop: raw concrete garage and gray concrete asphalt, cinematic graphite shadows, a golden afternoon stripe of sunlight across the floor and parts of the motorcycle, very restrained burnt orange reflection.
Composition/framing: wide landscape 16:9. Place the complete motorcycle on the RIGHT two-thirds of the image, facing right, with both wheels, mirrors and full body clearly visible. Leave the LEFT third as clean dark charcoal negative space for a website headline to be added separately; no distracting objects there.
Style/medium: premium photorealistic editorial automotive photography, cinematic but realistic lighting, tactile concrete and brushed metal.
Constraints: no person, no text, no logos, no watermark, no graphics, no interface. This is an illustrative fictional motorcycle.

prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: one single motorcycle catalog photograph for a Portuguese motorcycle rental website.
Scene/backdrop: seamless warm pale gray studio backdrop and floor (#e9e7e2 tone), neutral daylight, subtle natural shadow immediately beneath the tires. No props.
Style/medium: photorealistic professional product photography, realistic mechanical construction, precise tire and engine details.
Composition/framing: landscape 3:2 photograph. One complete motorcycle only, full three-quarter side view facing RIGHT, centered with generous clear margins all around. Both wheels, mirrors, handlebars and seat fully within frame. Camera at engine height, 70mm product-photo perspective.

Do not make it a dual sport or sport motorcycle.
